name: Michael A. Shakouri
tagline: Top rated Real Estate attorney in Los Angeles, California
education: University of San Diego School of Law
about: Michael A. Shakouri is a partner at the law firm Goodkin Law Group, APC, which is based in Los Angeles, California. He represents clients with matters related to real estate, business law, and insurance coverage and risk management. He serves clients in Los Angeles and throughout the California metro area.

Mr. Shakouri has extensive experience in civil action involving home lending, having previously worked at a prominent Orange County legal firm where he represented several major financial institutions. He puts his years of practice to work for his clients, guiding them efficiently through the legal system. This allows his clients to have a clear understanding of their legal situation and make informed decisions. He also takes the time to listen to his clients' concerns and provides personalized solutions that meet their specific needs.

Graduating cum laude with a major in economics and a minor in history, Mr. Shakouri completed his bachelor’s degree from the University of Southern California. He pursued law and attended the University of San Diego School of Law, where he earned his doctorate in jurisprudence in 2010.

Mr. Shakouri spent his summers as a law student working as an associate in the business affairs division of Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Pictures, Inc. Additionally, he helped low-income clients in a wide range of legal situations as part of a pro bono legal clinic at the University of San Diego.

Licensed to practice law in California, Mr. Shakouri is also authorized to practice before the U.S. District Courts for the Central and Southern Districts of California. Actively affiliated with the legal community, he is well-known in the legal arena for his noteworthy legal work. He holds memberships in the Iranian American Bar Association, the Los Angeles County Bar Association and the Orange County Bar Association.
